title: "Package 'my_pkg' not found" from ros2 run and ros2 launch: sourcing, install/, src/ builds and build_type, measured
excerpt: Why ros2 run, ros2 launch and ros2 pkg prefix report Package not found after a clean colcon build: unsourced or stale shells, --packages-select, building inside src/, a deleted install/ and a cmake or catkin build_type. Measured on Humble, Jazzy and Lyrical.
